description: A small sample question set over the public corpus in eval/plugin-docs-vault (a pinned snapshot of this plugin's own documentation). It exists to exercise scripts/evaluate-retrieval.mjs end to end for anyone, with no private vault: exact names, paraphrases, tasks, a complementary pair and a filtered state question, five of them with a labelled passage. It is not a measure of retrieval quality; the corpus is 36 pages, so the first ten results are 28% of it. Every expected page and passage is checked against the corpus by test/evaluator-sample.test.mjs.

questions.query: which rule says a substantive page has no route back to raw evidence
how is a scanned PDF with no text layer read
what stops two repair sessions working on one vault at the same time

expectedPassages.text: reserve an OS gate per vault

questions.query: re-clip a PDF whose table rows came out flattened
capture a GitHub repository as wiki evidence
check the pages a writing task produced for dead links
what to do with a leftover operation token
how installation of the plugin is configured for Codex
